Introduction

T:EV (short for Together : Forever) is a three-member South Korean boy group. They officially debuted on December 5, 2024, with their single album "Summer Day Story." All three members were previously part of the boy group AQA, and members Taeyeong and Yuseong also gained pre-debut experience as part of the trainee team Just COLOR and the busking group InnerS.

In April 2025, the group departed from Startree, the agency under which they debuted. As of now, T:EV is not signed to any entertainment company.
